items.text: Food biotechnology careers cover fermentation, enzymes, probiotics, quality testing, food safety and product development, and they depend on microbiology, process control and strict hygiene and labelling rules.
Learn food microbiology and quality basics, spend time in a food lab or plant and document one small product or testing project.
Verify licences and never sell or promote products with unverified health claims.
